#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Create a cover page and a sample report body for the Annual Financial Report PDF."""
from reportlab.lib.pagesizes import letter
from reportlab.lib.units import inch
from reportlab.pdfgen import canvas
from reportlab.lib.colors import HexColor
from textwrap import wrap

# ---------- Cover page ----------
cover = canvas.Canvas("cover_page.pdf", pagesize=letter)
width, height = letter

# Title
cover.setFont("Helvetica-Bold", 32)
cover.setFillColor(HexColor("#1a3a5c"))
cover.drawCentredString(width / 2, height - 3.5 * inch, "Annual Financial Report")

# Decorative line
cover.setStrokeColor(HexColor("#1a3a5c"))
cover.setLineWidth(2)
cover.line(width / 2 - 2 * inch, height - 4.0 * inch, width / 2 + 2 * inch, height - 4.0 * inch)

# Date
cover.setFont("Helvetica", 18)
cover.setFillColor(HexColor("#333333"))
cover.drawCentredString(width / 2, height - 4.8 * inch, "August 02, 2026")

# Subtitle
cover.setFont("Helvetica-Oblique", 12)
cover.setFillColor(HexColor("#666666"))
cover.drawCentredString(width / 2, 1.5 * inch, "Prepared by the Finance Department")
cover.save()

# ---------- Sample report body ----------
body = canvas.Canvas("report_body.pdf", pagesize=letter)
body.setTitle("Annual Financial Report")
width, height = letter

body.setFont("Helvetica-Bold", 18)
body.setFillColor(HexColor("#1a3a5c"))
body.drawString(1 * inch, height - 1 * inch, "Annual Financial Report")

body.setFont("Helvetica-Bold", 14)
body.setFillColor(HexColor("#000000"))
body.drawString(1 * inch, height - 1.5 * inch, "1. Executive Summary")

body.setFont("Helvetica", 11)
summary = (
    "This report summarizes the financial performance of the organization for the "
    "fiscal year ending June 30, 2026. Revenue grew by 12% year over year, while "
    "operating expenses increased by 6%, resulting in a net income of $4.2 million."
)
y = height - 1.8 * inch
for line in wrap(summary, width=95):
    body.drawString(1 * inch, y, line)
    y -= 0.25 * inch

y -= 0.3 * inch
body.setFont("Helvetica-Bold", 14)
body.drawString(1 * inch, y, "2. Key Financial Highlights")
y -= 0.3 * inch
body.setFont("Helvetica", 11)
highlights = [
    "Total Revenue: $18.7 million",
    "Operating Expenses: $14.5 million",
    "Net Income: $4.2 million",
    "Cash on Hand: $6.1 million",
]
for item in highlights:
    body.drawString(1 * inch, y, f"- {item}")
    y -= 0.25 * inch

y -= 0.3 * inch
body.setFont("Helvetica-Bold", 14)
body.drawString(1 * inch, y, "3. Outlook")
y -= 0.3 * inch
body.setFont("Helvetica", 11)
outlook = (
    "The organization expects continued growth in the coming fiscal year, with "
    "projected revenue of $21 million and continued investment in technology "
    "and talent acquisition."
)
for line in wrap(outlook, width=95):
    body.drawString(1 * inch, y, line)
    y -= 0.25 * inch

body.save()
print("Created cover_page.pdf and report_body.pdf")
